ECC.name: SAP ECC 6.0
ECC.note: SD and FI-AR tables via SLT, Openflow or a replication partner: VBAK/VBAP/VBEP + VBUK, LIKP/LIPS (incl. NL replenishment), EKKO/EKPO stock transport orders, VBRK/VBRP, KNA1/KNB1/KNKK, BSID/BSAD, FSCM UDMCASEATTR00 + SCMG_T_CASE_ATTR, FEBKO/FEBEP.

S4.name: SAP S/4HANA
S4.note: S/4 tables: VBUK/VBUP are gone (status on VBAK), receivables in ACDOCA with dunning in MHND, BUT000 business partners, UKMBP_CMS_SGM credit limits.

BW.name: SAP BW/4HANA
BW.note: SD and FI-AR ADSOs fed by 2LIS_11_VAITM/VASCL, 2LIS_12_VCITM, 2LIS_13_VDITM and 0FI_AR_4. No FSCM disputes and no bank statement lines.

BDC.name: SAP BDC
BDC.note: Zero-copy SAP BDC data products: Customer, SalesOrder, OutboundDelivery, BillingDocument, EntryViewJournalEntry. No disputes, bank lines or dunning data.

SALESFORCE.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud + CPQ
SALESFORCE.note: Account, User, SBQQ__Quote__c and SBQQ__QuoteLine__c. Quotes convert into SAP orders; accounts add segment and owner to SAP customers.

CARRIER.name: Carrier / TMS visibility (project44-style)
CARRIER.note: Shipments and tracking events keyed by the ERP delivery number: the true delivered date, plus exceptions, for OTIF.

VISIBILITY.name: Real-time visibility (project44 / FourKites style)
VISIBILITY.note: Every tendered shipment with origin and ship-to coordinates, the appointment date, a predictive ETA (early / on time / late) and GPS pings in transit; keyed by the ERP delivery number.

AR_AUTOMATION.name: AR automation (HighRadius-style)
AR_AUTOMATION.note: Disputes and deductions for every company code, synced to SAP FSCM where it is live; de-duplicated on the case id.

BANK.name: Bank statements (camt.053 / BAI2)
BANK.note: Incoming customer payments with remittance text on the four house-bank accounts; de-duplicated against SAP FEBEP on the bank reference.

profiles.name: SAP SLT / direct replication
profiles.note: Native table and column names and types, as SAP SLT, Snowflake Openflow or a replication partner configured for native shape lands them. Today's bronze.

profiles.name: Fivetran
profiles.vendor: Fivetran (SAP ERP on HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP OData connectors)
profiles.note: Uppercase names; '/' in SAP namespaces becomes '_'. Adds _FIVETRAN_SYNCED; soft-delete mode adds _FIVETRAN_DELETED, history mode adds _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE/_START/_END, no-trigger mode _FIVETRAN_ID.

profiles.name: Qlik Replicate
profiles.vendor: Qlik Replicate / Qlik Cloud Data Integration (SAP Application, SAP HANA endpoints)
profiles.note: Native names. DATS/TIMS often land as text. Soft deletes via an operation_indicator column (default DELETE_FLAG = 'D'); Store Changes writes <table>__CT change tables with header__ columns, which are ignored.

profiles.name: Other ELT tool (configurable)
profiles.vendor: SNP Glue, Theobald Xtract, Informatica, AWS AppFlow, Azure Data Factory, ...
profiles.note: Set OPTIONS on CONFIG.INGESTION: table_prefix, audit_columns (regex), delete_column + delete_value, cast_text_types.
